_comment: Every number a run reads. Region shape, site mix, the Reclaimer front, rewards and prices. Code holds none of these.

region._columns: Column 0 is the start site, the last column is the boss gate; the ones between hold rows_min..rows_max sites each.

front._comment: The Reclaimer consumes one column every `every` moves. Each move made while standing in consumed ground costs every machine `damage` HP (never below 1).

workshop._comment: repair_amount is per machine; a rebuilt wreck comes back at half HP

terrain._comment: Props and pits scattered on generated fights, in the middle rows, per fight: a random count in [min, max].

kinds._comment: Chance, per enemy and by column, that it has special rules, and which rules.

assembly._comment: Play-test 4: at the start of a run the crew is built from a bench. Every part at or below free_rarity is on it without limit; the extras (the default crew's uncommons) once each. RunSim.ASSEMBLE, before the first move only.

levels._comment: Play-test 3: scrap needs something to buy. In the garage a machine buys its next level for costs[level]. bonus[n] is what level n+1 adds: max HP (and that much HP now) and damage on every weapon and Charge. Tuned 2026-09-25: +1 damage on every level took the run bot from 85% to 94%.

hold._comment: The hold starts at `start` parts. A workshop sells `expand_by` more room at each price in turn. Going over is allowed after salvage, but travel waits until the hold fits.

scrap_value._comment: Scrap for breaking a part down, by rarity 1..3.
